finding.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
finding.summary: The handler writes the upload to a temp file carrying the client's own extension and calls Files.probeContentType(tempFile) believing this inspects the file's actual bytes, but on JDK 9+ the built-in Linux/Windows detectors key off the file name's extension, not content, so a renamed executable with an allowlisted extension passes while the allowlist check on the result validates nothing about what was actually uploaded.
